## What it checks (sampled describe/it titles)

- MemoryDiffEngine.diff — exact set arithmetic
- identical lists → no changes, all unchanged
- added in B, sorted ASC
- removed from A, sorted ASC
- changed: same id, different hash
- mixed: 1 added + 1 removed + 1 changed + 1 unchanged
